title: Cecil Stops by Again

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: Well, look who it is. Nivalis' grubbiest entrepreneur.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, look who it is. Nivalis' grubbiest entrepreneur.

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: Oh, but I can.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, but I can.

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: This isn't personal, you understand. It's about quotas. I must fulfil them. But thanks to the LUZ, there are only so many places to inspect and only so many fines I can issue...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This isn't personal, you understand. It's about quotas. I must fulfil them. But thanks to the LUZ, there are only so many places to inspect and only so many fines I can issue...

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: I’ll get demoted. To a sanitation categorization assistant. I’m built for fieldwork, not paper-pushing!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’ll get demoted. To a sanitation categorization assistant. I’m built for fieldwork, not paper-pushing!

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: You think I enjoy this? I get barely any satisfaction from issuing such grubby little penalties.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think I enjoy this? I get barely any satisfaction from issuing such grubby little penalties.

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: Yes. Today it will be... forty Lims, I think. I'm feeling generous.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. Today it will be... forty Lims, I think. I'm feeling generous.

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: I would be so far above you, I wouldn't even see the bird excrement that covers your roof.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I would be so far above you, I wouldn't even see the bird excrement that covers your roof.

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: I assure you all the paperwork is in order. Have an immaculate day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I assure you all the paperwork is in order. Have an immaculate day.

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: You do? If I told you about some of the things I'd seen... improper utensil storage... cross contamination...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You do? If I told you about some of the things I'd seen... improper utensil storage... cross contamination...

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: Exactly! I should be out in the field, face-to-face with bacterial horrors, getting my gloves dirty…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly! I should be out in the field, face-to-face with bacterial horrors, getting my gloves dirty…

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: If I was promoted to the Spire, I could issue Category B fines all day long--

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I was promoted to the Spire, I could issue Category B fines all day long--

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: Another inspection. That's my job.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Another inspection. That's my job.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just give me the fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just give me the fine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happens if you don't meet your quotas?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happens if you don't meet your quotas?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What happens if you don't meet your quotas?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What happens if you don't meet your quotas?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Boo hoo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Boo hoo.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And if you issue enough fines, you'll be promoted to the Spire and leave me alone?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And if you issue enough fines, you'll be promoted to the Spire and leave me alone?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And if you issue enough fines, you'll be promoted to the Spire and leave me alone?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And if you issue enough fines, you'll be promoted to the Spire and leave me alone?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can I just have my fine now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can I just have my fine now?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can I just have my fine now?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can I just have my fine now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're a crook.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're a crook.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're too kind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're too kind.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I love it when you talk dirty to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I love it when you talk dirty to me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I love it when you talk dirty to me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I love it when you talk dirty to me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You better give me that fine before things get too heated.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You better give me that fine before things get too heated.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You better give me that fine before things get too heated.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You better give me that fine before things get too heated.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Going toe-to-toe! Smelling the blood!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Going toe-to-toe! Smelling the blood!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A real warrior! Working the trenches.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A real warrior! Working the trenches.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: A real warrior! Working the trenches.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: A real warrior! Working the trenches.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I really pity you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I really pity you!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Actually? It seems like you do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Actually? It seems like you do.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Actually? It seems like you do.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Actually? It seems like you do.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You can't be here for another inspection...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You can't be here for another inspection...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You can't be here for another inspection...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You can't be here for another inspection...
